title: Stretch Marks Treatment Cost in Dubai
h1: Stretch marks treatment in Dubai: what works and what it costs
desc: What works for stretch marks and what it costs in Dubai: Morpheus8 Pro from AED 1,999 + VAT, laser from AED 500 + VAT, Fotona from AED 999 + VAT, and how many sessions.
answer: At Skin & Laser in Dubai Marina, stretch marks are mainly treated with Morpheus8 Pro RF microneedling, which costs AED 1,999 + VAT for the half abdomen and AED 3,500 + VAT for the full abdomen, inner or outer thighs or half arms, with PRP included. Laser for a small area starts at AED 500 + VAT and Fotona at AED 999 + VAT. Most people need 3 or more sessions, 4 to 6 weeks apart.
body:
## What actually works

Creams improve how skin feels but do not rebuild collagen deep inside a stretch mark. The treatments with the most consistent results rebuild that collagen: RF microneedling such as Morpheus8 Pro, and resurfacing lasers such as Fotona and fractional CO2. Newer red or purple marks also respond to gentle Nd:YAG laser, which calms the redness. No treatment erases stretch marks completely, but they can become flatter, smoother and much closer to your skin tone.

## Prices by treatment and area

- **Morpheus8 Pro, half abdomen:** AED 1,999 + VAT
- **Morpheus8 Pro, full abdomen, inner or outer thighs, or half arms:** AED 3,500 + VAT
- **Morpheus8 Pro, full thighs:** AED 5,500 + VAT
- **Laser rejuvenation, small area or scars:** from AED 500 + VAT
- **Fotona laser, small to medium area:** AED 999 + VAT

PRP is included in every Morpheus8 Pro session.

## How many sessions to budget for

Most people need 3 or more sessions, 4 to 6 weeks apart. Red marks usually improve faster than old white ones, so starting early can reduce the total. For example, a course of 3 Morpheus8 Pro sessions on the half abdomen is AED 5,997 + VAT, and on the full abdomen AED 10,500 + VAT. Your doctor confirms the plan, so you know the total before you start.

## Red or white marks

- **Red or purple (newer):** Nd:YAG laser plus RF microneedling often works well and faster.
- **White or silver (older):** collagen needs rebuilding with Morpheus8 Pro, Fotona or fractional CO2, and change is more gradual.

## Darker skin and Dubai sun

On darker or tanned skin, RF microneedling is often preferred to CO2 because it carries a lower risk of pigment change. Keep treated areas out of the sun for several weeks and avoid tanning before sessions.

## After pregnancy

Energy-based treatments are not used during pregnancy. Treatment is planned afterwards; if you are breastfeeding, your doctor confirms the timing. Full details are on [stretch marks treatment](/stretch-marks-treatment-dubai/) and [Morpheus8 Pro](/treatments/morpheus8-dubai/). If the skin around the marks is also loose, see [loose skin after weight loss](/loose-skin-treatment-dubai/).
